systems.system: Guichets Fonciers (commune land offices) and the national land-certificate database
systems.owner: communes; diagnostic and national database by the Ministère de l'Aménagement du Territoire et des Services Fonciers
systems.tiers: 524 communes with a Guichet Foncier surveyed February to May 2026; 65% of the offices work manually on paper and without electricity; 911,744 certificates in the national database

note: The ministry's diagnostic says 65% of commune land offices are on paper and without electricity; it states nothing about a data connection at the commune office, so no fact for the connection sub-indicator.
